signing.user_warning: Windows may show a Microsoft Defender SmartScreen or unknown-publisher warning because this direct-download build is not trusted-signed yet.

safe_claims: The ordinary Windows UI uses the authenticated POKROVService runtime lane and does not load POKROV Core directly.
The local pre-candidate build bundles the exact POKROV Core 1.1.0 replacement bytes, its pinned libcronet.dll dependency, and pokrov_service.exe in one machine-wide installation directory.
The installer performs the one-time administrative SCM registration; the ordinary UI does not receive privileged file, path, or shell execution.

Local packaging may produce an unsigned direct-download Inno Setup installer with the SmartScreen warning above; it remains ineligible for candidate promotion until UI, service, installer and embedded uninstaller pass the trusted Authenticode contract.
Trusted signing accepts no PFX path or password: the private key remains in the selected Windows certificate store and only public certificate and timestamp evidence enters the manifest.
